extractionrun.settings.page.title: Search-Loot-Extract Settings
extractionrun.settings.maxCards.descript: Maximum number of cards you can carry into a run.
extractionrun.settings.maxRelics.descrip: Maximum number of relics you can carry into a run.
extractionrun.settings.showCardHoverTips: Show vanilla tooltips when hovering over cards.
extractionrun.settings.showRelicHoverTip: Show vanilla tooltips when hovering over relics.
extractionrun.settings.showPotionHoverTi: Show vanilla tooltips when hovering over potions.
extractionrun.settings.durability.enable: Cards and relics lose 1 durability per successful extraction; at 0 a copy is lost. Disabling switches the warehouse to a disposable no-durability copy (progress there is lost when re-enabling).
Max durability granted to a new starter-rarity card.
extractionrun.settings.durability.common: Max durability granted to a new common-rarity card.
extractionrun.settings.durability.uncomm: Max durability granted to a new uncommon-rarity card.
extractionrun.settings.durability.rare.d: Max durability granted to a new rare-rarity card.
extractionrun.settings.durability.ancien: Max durability granted to a new ancient-rarity card.
Max durability granted to cards of any other rarity (event/token/status/curse/quest, mod cards).
Max durability granted to a new relic (all relics share one value).
Show copies of the same card or relic with different durability as separate tiles.
Limit carried cards and relics by a shared backpack capacity (cards cost by rarity, relics a flat amount). Disabling reverts to the max card / relic count caps.
extractionrun.settings.capacity.total.de: Total capacity shared by carried cards and relics.
extractionrun.settings.capacity.basicCom: Backpack slots one starter- or common-rarity card occupies.
extractionrun.settings.capacity.uncommon: Backpack slots one uncommon-rarity card occupies.
extractionrun.settings.capacity.rare.des: Backpack slots one rare-rarity card occupies.
Backpack slots one ancient-rarity card occupies.
extractionrun.settings.capacity.other.de: Backpack slots a card of any other rarity occupies (event/token/status/curse/quest).
extractionrun.settings.capacity.relic.de: Backpack slots one relic occupies (all relics share one value).
extractionrun.settings.shop.buyMultiplie: Multiplier applied to the rolled vanilla shop price when buying.
extractionrun.settings.shop.sellRatio.de: Ratio of the vanilla base price paid when selling (before the durability factor).
extractionrun.settings.shop.multiplayerC: Allow shop refreshes to roll multiplayer-only cards. Takes effect on the next refresh.
extractionrun.settings.loot.enabled.desc: Before revealing rewards on card-choice, merchant and treasure-chest screens, play a magnifier search reveal. Extraction runs only.
Seconds spent searching a starter/common-rarity item.
extractionrun.settings.loot.uncommon.des: Seconds spent searching an uncommon-rarity item.
extractionrun.settings.loot.rare.descrip: Seconds spent searching a rare-rarity item.
extractionrun.settings.loot.ancient.desc: Seconds spent searching an ancient-rarity item.
extractionrun.settings.loot.other.descri: Seconds spent searching any other rarity
extractionrun.settings.loot.skipKey.desc: Press this key to reveal every remaining item instantly. Clicking the item being searched reveals it and advances.
extractionrun.settings.extractionPoint.c: Capacity of the 普通撤离 carry-out panel in act 1 (rarity-weight slots, cards + relics share the pool).
Capacity of the 普通撤离 carry-out panel in act 2.
Capacity of the 普通撤离 carry-out panel in act 3 and beyond.
extractionrun.settings.extractionPoint.g: Base gold cost of the 金币撤离 option in act 1; the cost compounds by the rate below each act.
Compounded per-act increase of the gold fee (e.g. 20% = 100 → 120 → 144).
extractionrun.settings.extractionPoint.a: Chance each act rolls an extraction point at act start. At most one is ever placed per run.
extractionrun.settings.reset.label: Restore Defaults
extractionrun.settings.reset.description: Restore all Search-Loot-Extract settings to their default values.
